body:
Hey there! Writing is eating up your time, so this week we're covering the AI tools that handle it best—from quick copy to long-form content and SEO optimization.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, edit, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. If you're already using Notion for projects or docs, this is the no-brainer upgrade that keeps everything in one place.
*Free + $10/mo | [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)*

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy, social posts, and ad variations in seconds. Best for owners who need fast, varied copy options without hiring a copywriter.
*Free + $36/mo | [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)*

**Surfer SEO**
Write and optimize content to actually rank on Google, not just exist. If you're publishing blog posts or landing pages, this saves the guesswork on what Google wants to see.
*$89/mo | [Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)*

---

## Quick Tip

Don't use AI to replace your voice—use it to speed up your first draft. Write a rough outline, let AI expand it, then spend your time editing and adding the human touch that makes your brand memorable. That 20% of effort gets you 80% of the way there.

---

See you next week with more tools that actually work for your business.
